comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body:
Not building this, and the reason is measured rather than a change of taste.

The fake existed because a real daemon was assumed too slow for the default gate. It is not: 25 ms to spawn and answer, 0.7 ms for a snapshot, 0.7 ms for a full mirror bootstrap, 30 repeat runs with no flakes. The seconds-per-test cost belongs to agent detection, which screen-scrapes on a hardcoded 2s timer, and tests set agent state through the API instead.

So there is no hand-written herdr anywhere in this repo, and the top false-green risk testing.md names stops being one we manage. See docs/testing.md and commit ac48039.

What replaced its two jobs: realism comes from a pinned real daemon (deps/herdr.pin, fetched and checksummed by ./dev); fault injection comes from the code's own shape - the event parser takes a reader so a recorded stream can be cut anywhere, and killing a real daemon ends a subscription in 0.8 ms. A proxy that corrupted real traffic was considered and rejected: it would put byte-level protocol emulation back.

creator: Alexander Terp
description: In-process fake speaking the published herdr-api.schema.json at the socket seam: layout.export, events.subscribe, terminal session control streams. The IT edge for everything above the wire.
title: Fake herdr daemon for the test harness
